title: RPM update: terminal handle sizing and Automount discovery
summary: The terminal handle responds correctly to maximized windows on GNOME 51, and Automount detects drives whose details become available after initial discovery.

changes.title: Available through InfinityUpdater
changes.text: This signed RPM update was published for ARM64 and x64 and is included in the current repository packages. The existing TV Mode installer images do not include these later changes.

changes.title: Handle sizing on maximized windows
changes.text: The pull handle reads GNOME 51's vertical maximization state directly, so it becomes compact even when a small gap remains between the window and the top bar.

changes.title: Delayed volume discovery
changes.text: Automount rescans when a volume changes, allowing a selected drive to mount after its UUID and mount capability become available. Manually unmounted drives remain unmounted.

title: RPM update: terminal widgets stay hidden on collapse and lock
summary: InfinityTerminal hides its widgets immediately when collapsing and keeps them off the lock screen.

changes.title: Available through InfinityUpdater
changes.text: This signed RPM update was published for ARM64 and x64 and is included in the current repository packages. The existing TV Mode installer images do not include these later changes.

changes.title: Reliable collapse and reopen
changes.text: Widgets and their menu disappear as soon as the terminal starts closing. An interrupted animation still finishes minimizing the window, while reopening cancels the old closing callback.

changes.title: Lock screen visibility
changes.text: Widgets and the resize handle stay hidden while the screen shield, lock screen or login mode is active. The widget strip and its popup menu are also stacked below the screen shield.

title: RPM update: steadier terminal widget readings
summary: InfinityTerminal refreshes hardware readings more reliably and avoids misleading network speeds when network interfaces change.

changes.title: Available through InfinityUpdater
changes.text: This signed RPM update was published for ARM64 and x64 and is included in the current repository packages. The existing TV Mode installer images do not include these later changes.

changes.title: Hardware refresh and widget order
changes.text: Hiding the widget strip stops sensor sampling and discards stale results, so an older request cannot overwrite a newer reading. Dragging widgets uses the current saved order after the drop completes.

changes.title: Network and battery readings
changes.text: Transfer speeds compare counters per interface, avoiding spikes when interfaces appear or disappear. Failed network reads clear the old reading, and missing battery data no longer produces an invalid percentage.

title: RPM update: terminal widgets hide with the window
summary: InfinityTerminal widgets and the resize handle disappear with the terminal when you show the desktop or close the window.

changes.title: Available through InfinityUpdater
changes.text: The signed RPM update is available for ARM64 and x64. The existing TV Mode installer images do not include this later fix; installed systems can receive it through InfinityUpdater.

changes.title: Show Desktop and window visibility
changes.text: Widgets follow the terminal window's actual visibility, including Show Desktop when the window is hidden without being minimized. They return when the terminal becomes visible again.

changes.title: Clean window closure
changes.text: Closing the terminal hides its widgets and resize handle even while the old window remains in the compositor. Window tracking no longer refers to the removed panel icon.

title: RPM update: tray icons stay on the top bar
summary: Tray icons moved to the top bar keep their placement after an application restart or system reboot, including Discord.

changes.title: Available through InfinityUpdater
changes.text: The signed RPM update is available for ARM64 and x64. The existing TV Mode installer images do not include this later fix; installed systems can receive it through InfinityUpdater.

changes.title: Persistent app placement
changes.text: Tray preferences use a stable application identity instead of a changing process or D-Bus connection. Electron applications with shared tray IDs are distinguished by their application identity.

changes.title: Restore saved choices
changes.text: Saved placement is restored when an application publishes its tray identity late. Earlier legacy tray preferences are recognized after process IDs change, and moving an icon back to the menu remains persistent.

title: RPM update: pinned terminal tabs recover after shell exit
summary: InfinityTerminal opens a fresh shell when the last terminal in a pinned tab exits, keeping the tab usable.

changes.title: Available through InfinityUpdater
changes.text: This fix was published as a signed RPM update for ARM64 and x64 and is included in subsequent repository updates. The existing TV Mode installer images do not contain it.

changes.title: Recover empty pinned tabs
changes.text: When a pinned tab becomes empty, InfinityTerminal creates a new interactive Zsh shell. Infinity AI, Codex CLI, Claude CLI and Antigravity CLI tab titles are preserved.

changes.title: Shell dependency
changes.text: The InfinityTerminal package explicitly requires Zsh so the replacement shell is available.

title: TV Mode input, Automount and DNF updates
summary: The TV session prepares keyboard and controller access for ES-DE. Steam uses drives selected in Nautilus, and DNF applies InfinityOS updates with Fedora's vendor protection enabled.

changes.title: Release availability
changes.text: The verified x64 and ARM64 installer images are available on the Download page with SHA-256 and MD5 checksums. The signed RPM update is also available through InfinityUpdater.

changes.title: Fedora 45 package updates
changes.text: The DNF5 vendor policy allows upgrades from the signed InfinityOS repositories without requiring an extra command-line flag. Gamescope, Nautilus and Nautilus Extensions were verified in one Fedora transaction.

changes.title: Automount for protected drives
changes.text: Enabling Automount asks for administrator approval once when a protected drive requires it. The approval is tied to the selected user and disk and is reused after restart. An earlier selection can be switched off and back on to record approval.

changes.title: ES-DE and Steam TV Mode
changes.text: ES-DE starts on the active TV virtual terminal after input devices have had time to register. With xone installed it uses the kernel input path for Xbox One and Series controllers. Steam mounts available drives selected in Nautilus and continues watching for reconnects across Steam restarts.

title: First-boot updates and fullscreen fixes
summary: InfinityOS prepares backups and package metadata on first boot. InfinityTerminal hides its pull handle and floating three-dot button while an application is fullscreen.

changes.title: Available through InfinityUpdater
changes.text: The signed fixes are available through InfinityUpdater on x64 and ARM64. Both ISO builds succeeded and their artifacts are present, but the Cloudflare R2 publication was cancelled. These fixes are not included in the earlier Pinokio installer images.

changes.title: First-boot recovery and updates
changes.text: Backup setup waits for pending EFI repair, and InfinityUpdater can retry backup initialization before preparing an offline upgrade. New installations refresh their own package metadata.

changes.title: Gamescope and Nautilus on x64
changes.text: Gamescope 3.16.31 retains the Steam Big Picture fix for NVIDIA. The release checks verify that Gamescope, Nautilus and Nautilus Extensions upgrade together on Fedora 45.

changes.title: Fullscreen applications
changes.text: The InfinityTerminal pull handle hides over fullscreen apps and returns when fullscreen ends. The floating three-dot button is removed. Maximized windows keep the compact handle.

changes.title: GitHub release checks
changes.text: InfinityUpdater caches third-party release lookups and waits before retrying after a GitHub rate limit. System package checks continue independently.

title: Pinokio, desktop shortcuts and drive Automount
summary: InfinityApps adds Pinokio, the Infinity logo opens the app grid, and Nautilus can remember which drives to mount when you sign in.

changes.title: Release availability
changes.text: The x64 and ARM64 installer images are available on Cloudflare R2 with SHA-256 and MD5 checksums on the Download page. The signed update is available through InfinityUpdater.

changes.title: Pinokio in InfinityApps
changes.text: Find Pinokio at the bottom of the AI tab with its official icon and download link. InfinityApps verifies the native RPM before installing it.

changes.title: App grid and keyboard shortcuts
changes.text: Click the Infinity logo to open the app grid. Super+D shows the desktop and restores windows when pressed again. Super+E opens your Home folder in Nautilus.

changes.title: Nautilus drive Automount
changes.text: Right-click a local volume in Nautilus and select Automount. Chosen volumes mount in the background at sign-in or when reconnected. Unavailable and ambiguous volumes are skipped, and a slow mount request times out without holding up the desktop.

title: Installer fix for rEFInd boot entries
summary: Fixes a final-stage installation error on some x64 UEFI systems where the installer could not recognize the rEFInd entry it had just created.

changes.title: Release availability
changes.text: The updated x64 and ARM64 installer images are available on Cloudflare R2. The Download page lists their SHA-256 and MD5 checksums. The signed update is also available for existing installations.

changes.title: EFI boot entry recognition
changes.text: The installer recognizes both forms of EFI loader paths printed by efibootmgr. It matches the exact rEFInd loader and EFI system partition before adding the entry to the boot order.

changes.title: Regression coverage
changes.text: A dual-boot test reproduces the reported x64 failure and verifies that rEFInd is activated on the target disk.

title: InfinityApps and a clearer install review
summary: InfinityApps is the InfinityOS application chooser. Its redesigned confirmation shows exactly what will be installed, removed, or changed in TV Mode.

changes.title: Available on ARM64 and x64
changes.text: The ARM64 and x64 installer images are published to Cloudflare R2. Get the images and their SHA-256 and MD5 checksums on the Download page. Existing installations can get the signed update through InfinityUpdater.

changes.title: Review your selection
changes.text: The confirmation groups changes by action and shows app icons and counts. Install-only selections have a dedicated Install button.

changes.title: Close during setup or installation
changes.text: The close button is available while the catalog loads. During an installation, closing lets the current operation finish, stops the remaining queue, and then closes the window.

changes.title: Search, AI and Antigravity
changes.text: CraftSuite appears in search. Refreshing AI model availability preserves other app selections and the active search. The Antigravity entry uses the Google G, and retrying a partial desktop installation repairs it.

title: RPM update: Google Antigravity, shared blur and model management
summary: InfinityApps adds Google Antigravity, InfinityTerminal gets a pinned Antigravity CLI tab, and InfinityConfig shows downloaded AI models.

changes.title: Available for ARM64 and x64
changes.text: Install the signed RPM update through InfinityUpdater. The installer images from build 115451b can receive this update after installation.

changes.title: Google Antigravity and InfinityTerminal
changes.text: InfinityApps can install the Google Antigravity desktop app and the official agy command-line tool on both architectures. Once agy is installed, InfinityTerminal adds a pinned Antigravity CLI tab, including when reopening the terminal drawer.

changes.title: Matching blur in InfinityApps and InfinityConfig
changes.text: InfinityApps and InfinityConfig share the GNOME Shell backdrop used by InfinityUpdater. Both use a solid background when the blur is unavailable.

changes.title: Downloaded models in InfinityConfig
changes.text: InfinityConfig lists downloaded AI models even when no model is active. InfinityApps shows the models available to download.

title: InfinityOS _02 installer update for ARM64 and x64
summary: Fresh Fedora 45 and GNOME 51 images bring together safer EFI repair, backup reliability improvements and the recent desktop and updater changes.

changes.title: Downloads and updates
changes.text: Both installer images are available from the Download page with SHA-256 and MD5 checksums. The fixes are also available to existing installations through the signed RPM repository.

changes.title: EFI repair on multi-disk systems
changes.text: rEFInd activation finds the entry for the mounted EFI partition and the expected loader. Cleanup preserves firmware entries on other EFI partitions. When the boot order is already correct, activation skips the firmware write. If the RPM database cannot be read, obsolete-loader cleanup stops.

changes.title: First-boot backups and recovery
changes.text: Backup setup waits for any boot repair scheduled in the same boot, keeps valid Btrfs root mount options, and gives clearer diagnostics when snapshot initialization is incomplete.

changes.title: Desktop layouts and window decorations
changes.text: Desktop icons remember separate monitor layouts and preserve their original docked positions when the first login after an upgrade happens undocked. The bundled Orchis window-decoration XML is corrected.

changes.title: Dock, updater and cursor polish
changes.text: The dock uses panel-matched live blur. InfinityUpdater avoids dark hover artifacts, slides in without a bounce, groups dependency-held packages separately and retries a failed repository download after refreshing metadata. The waiting glove animates in native GNOME 51 apps.

changes.title: Terminal, tray and RAMDrive
changes.text: The application grid opens InfinityTerminal in its pull-down drawer. Tray icons are centered in Quick Settings. Before a restart, RAMDrive can move its contents to Saved Files on the desktop or clear them when requested.

title: RPM update: firmware boot order and repair tools
summary: rEFInd activation handles stale firmware boot references, and InfinityApps includes the tools needed to retry an interrupted boot setup.

changes.title: Available as an RPM update
changes.text: Published for ARM64 and x64 in the app chooser RPM 1.0.2-10000483.fc45. Existing ISO downloads are unchanged and do not include this fix.

changes.title: Stale firmware entries
changes.text: rEFInd activation now omits boot-order references whose firmware entries no longer exist, preventing them from blocking activation. It removes duplicate references while preserving the relative order of other defined entries, including inactive devices and other operating systems. Other firmware boot variables are not deleted.

changes.title: Consistent activation checks
changes.text: The helper reads boot entries and their order from the same firmware snapshot and refreshes it after creating an Infinity OS entry. It can initialize a missing boot order. Invalid identifiers and actual firmware read, creation or write errors still stop activation.

changes.title: Repair tools for existing installations
changes.text: InfinityApps now ships the current boot-conversion and obsolete-loader cleanup helpers with their required dependencies. Administrators can use them to retry an interrupted setup. Installing the RPM does not start boot conversion automatically, and systems blocked by incomplete backup initialization may still need administrator repair before normal updates can proceed.

title: RPM update: backup initialization and diagnostics
summary: InfinityUpdater includes the Snapper initialization tools, more reliable backup readiness checks and clearer guidance when backup setup is incomplete.

changes.title: Available as an RPM update
changes.text: Published for ARM64 and x64 in infinity-updater 1.1.1-10000481.fc45. Existing ISO downloads are unchanged. The related installer changes are not included in the current ISO.

changes.title: Initialization tools included
changes.text: The updater package now includes the Snapper initializer, its service and shared backup-service presets. First installation applies the presets without starting storage migration during the RPM transaction. Package upgrades preserve administrator choices about enabled services. Initialization skips live sessions and requires a Btrfs root.

changes.title: Reliable backup readiness
changes.text: Backup setup checks the EFI partition, completed rEFInd installation and kernel command line before changing snapshot storage. It reports readiness only after refreshing the recovery menu successfully. Interrupted setup can be retried, including when an old marker exists but the required configuration or snapshot mount is missing.

changes.title: Clearer update errors
changes.text: The updater distinguishes missing Snapper configuration, incomplete backup setup and unmounted snapshot storage. It identifies disabled, masked or failed initialization services and points to the relevant logs instead of suggesting that a restart always fixes the problem. Release upgrades also require completed backup initialization.

changes.title: Existing affected installations
changes.text: The backup prerequisite remains enforced. Systems where initialization was missed may need administrator repair before this RPM can be installed through InfinityUpdater. The update does not silently repair an incomplete bootloader installation or re-enable deliberately disabled services.

changes.title: Recovery tools stay current
changes.text: Restoring an older root now carries forward the current Snapper initializer, service and presets alongside the backup tools. Initialization also repairs the copied Snapper configuration's SELinux context when restorecon is available.

title: RPM update: desktop icon layouts for each monitor setup
summary: Desktop icons remember separate positions for laptop-only and external-monitor layouts, including changes made while undocked.

changes.title: Available as an RPM update
changes.text: Published for ARM64 and x64 in infinityos-shell-extensions 1.0.0-10000479.fc45. Log out of the desktop and log back in after installation to load the updated extension. Existing ISO downloads are unchanged.

changes.title: Separate desktop layouts
changes.text: Icon positions are saved for up to 16 monitor configurations, based on screen arrangement, resolution and scale. Moving icons on the laptop no longer replaces their saved positions for an external-monitor setup. Saved layouts survive logging out and back in.

changes.title: Restore positions after reconnecting
changes.text: Icons from a disconnected screen move onto available desktop space. Reconnecting the original configuration restores its saved positions where space permits. Temporary rearrangement does not overwrite preferred positions, and changing monitor order or the primary screen does not reset the layout.

changes.title: Placement fixes
changes.text: Corrected the vertical distance used to choose a fallback screen. Changing only the primary monitor now updates the destination for new desktop files without rebuilding the existing icon layout.

title: RPM update: native GNOME waiting-cursor playback
summary: The finger-drumming glove now includes GNOME 51 scalable animation assets for native waiting and application-startup cursors.

changes.title: Available as an RPM update
changes.text: Published for ARM64 and x64 in infinityos-shell-extensions 1.0.0-10000476.fc45. Log out of the desktop and log back in after installation to reload the cursor theme. Existing ISO downloads are unchanged.

changes.title: Native GNOME 51 animation
changes.text: The theme now supplies wait and progress through GNOME 51's scalable SVG cursor format, alongside the legacy Xcursor files. Both use the approved 40-frame, 800 ms finger-drumming sequence with a stationary palm, thumb, cuff and hotspot.

changes.title: Verified in a normal Wayland application
changes.text: Native GNOME 51 tests confirm that both waiting shapes advance while the pointer stays still over a real GTK Wayland window, without a modal Shell input grab or a forced stage cursor. The test records 37 frame changes in 750 ms with stable size and hotspot.

title: RPM update: the waiting glove drums its fingers
summary: The waiting cursor now uses the approved finger-drumming animation, with a stationary palm, thumb and cuff.

changes.title: Available as an RPM update
changes.text: Published for ARM64 and x64 in infinityos-shell-extensions 1.0.0-10000463.fc45. Log out of the desktop and log back in after installation to reload the cursor theme. Existing ISO downloads are unchanged.

changes.title: Visible finger tapping
changes.text: The four fingers bend toward their knuckles in an overlapping sequence, following the approved animated preview. The palm, thumb, cuff and cursor hotspot remain fixed.

changes.title: Waiting and application startup
changes.text: Wait, progress and the existing busy cursor aliases share 40 frames across an 800 ms loop. The first tap begins immediately, so short operations can show motion without waiting for an initial pause.

changes.title: Native animation verified
changes.text: The packaged cursor includes sizes from 16 to 128 pixels. GNOME 51 tests confirm that wait and progress advance through animation frames while the pointer stays still, with stable size and hotspot.

title: RPM update: live dock blur rendering fixed
summary: Live background blur now renders correctly beneath the animated dock, while keeping its panel-matched tint and transparent fallback.

changes.title: Available as an RPM update
changes.text: Published for ARM64 and x64 in infinityos-shell-extensions 1.0.0-10000456.fc45. Log out of the desktop and log back in after installing it to load the updated extension. Existing ISO downloads are unchanged.

changes.title: Wallpaper edges blur beneath the dock
changes.text: Fixes a case where the dock showed a tint but the wallpaper remained sharp despite an active blur effect. The dock no longer forces its entire surface into a separate rendering cache. Icon rendering and the rounded outline are preserved.

changes.title: Blur stays visible during animation
changes.text: The dock's animation and transparency updates keep the matching backdrop visible and allow it to follow the dock's size. Overview transparency preferences are preserved.

changes.title: Transparent fallback
changes.text: The dock continues to use the panel and InfinityUpdater blur settings and tint layers. If that backdrop is unavailable, the dock remains transparent. The rendering fix was confirmed in a running VM and checked with native GNOME 51 tests.

title: RPM update: dock background follows the panel
summary: The adaptive dock shares the panel and InfinityUpdater backdrop settings, with matching tint layers and a transparent fallback.

changes.title: Available as an RPM update
changes.text: Published in the Infinity OS 2.0 RPM repository for ARM64 and x64 as package release 10000446.fc45. This is not a new ISO. The latest verified ISO build, 1121f5365d587876e9c220afdbcf1702054598b9, does not include these changes.

changes.title: Shared backdrop settings
changes.text: The adaptive dock uses the same backdrop provider as the panel and InfinityUpdater. It follows the panel's live blur and brightness settings or static preset, with rounded clipping. Wallpaper sampling still follows each surface's screen position.

changes.title: Matching tint layers
changes.text: The dock paints the panel background and visible tint layers in the same order and opacity as InfinityUpdater. These replace the adaptive dock's separate neutral tint while retaining its existing outline.

changes.title: Fallback and recovery
changes.text: If the matching backdrop is unavailable, the adaptive dock remains transparent. It rebuilds the backdrop when its mode, corner radius or panel provider changes. Custom backgrounds and panel mode keep their existing styling.

title: RPM update: save RAMDrive files before restarting
summary: Available through InfinityUpdater on ARM64 and x64: choose whether to save or remove RAMDrive files before a desktop restart.

changes.title: Available as an RPM update
changes.text: Published in the Infinity OS 2.0 RPM repository for ARM64 and x64. This change is not included in the latest verified ISO build, 1121f5365d587876e9c220afdbcf1702054598b9.

changes.title: Choose before restarting
changes.text: When RAMDrive contains files, the desktop restart dialog appears in the upper-right corner with Remove & Restart and Save files. The countdown pauses while a choice is pending. Press Escape to cancel before an operation starts.

changes.title: Save files to the Desktop
changes.text: Save files moves RAMDrive contents to Saved Files on your configured Desktop, then continues the restart. Hidden files and nested folders are included. Existing saved files are kept, with numeric suffixes added to conflicting names.

changes.title: Restart only after success
changes.text: Remove & Restart clears RAMDrive before continuing. A failed operation or remaining files stops the restart and displays an error. Files already moved during a partial save remain in Saved Files; the rest stay in RAMDrive. GNOME's update and session checks are preserved.

title: RPM updates: desktop polish and update recovery
summary: Available through InfinityUpdater on ARM64 and x64: a tapping glove cursor, updater and dock fixes, clearer dependency handling, and more reliable authorization and downloads.

changes.title: Available as RPM updates
changes.text: These changes are published in the Infinity OS 2.0 RPM repository for ARM64 and x64. They are not a new ISO release. The latest verified ISO build remains 1121f5365d587876e9c220afdbcf1702054598b9 and does not include the changes below.

changes.title: Tapping glove cursor
changes.text: The busy cursor now shows a stationary glove tapping its fingers instead of a spinning beachball. Tapping starts immediately, with a fixed palm and pointer position across supported cursor sizes.

changes.title: Updater appearance and motion
changes.text: Removed dark rectangular shadows and hover artifacts over the blurred background. The header now matches the backdrop, with a System update title and a compact refresh button. The window slides into place without an opening bounce and respects reduced-motion settings.

changes.title: Dock blur
changes.text: Restored blur behind the visible dock, with its size and rounded corners following the dock background.

changes.title: Packages waiting for compatibility
changes.text: RPM updates blocked by incompatible dependencies appear in a separate expandable group. They are excluded from the ready-to-install count and installation actions, then offered automatically when compatible dependencies become available.

changes.title: Tray and top bar
changes.text: Centered tray icons inside their cells and removed empty space left by hidden indicators. The top bar hides the power-profile icon and connected Ethernet icon, while keeping Wi-Fi and disconnected-network status visible.

changes.title: Open InfinityTerminal from applications
changes.text: Opening InfinityTerminal from the application list now uses its pull-down drawer. It waits for the overview to close and focuses the existing terminal when it is already visible.

changes.title: Update authorization
changes.text: The updater stays visible while the administrator password dialog is open and shows an Authorizing phase. Authorization failures and unexpected helper errors are reported instead of leaving the interface busy indefinitely.

changes.title: Download recovery
changes.text: If an offline repository download fails, the updater refreshes repository metadata and retries once. Downloaded packages and the existing offline transaction are preserved. Local RPM installs and the restart step are not retried.

title: Terminal handle, dock and updater
summary: Glove cursors and smoother terminal dragging, consistent dock corners, updater blur, and tray and update-list fixes.

changes.title: Terminal handle
changes.text: The handle uses the top bar's actual blur and reconnects when the panel background reloads. An open glove appears on hover and closes while dragging.

changes.title: Drag without bounce
changes.text: Pulling the terminal by hand follows the pointer and settles without bounce. Clicking the handle or pressing Super+T keeps the bounce animation.

changes.title: Dock corners
changes.text: The lower corners use the same outline color as the sides. The thicker top edge is unchanged.

changes.title: InfinityUpdater background
changes.text: The ISO window uses the top bar's blur with slightly darker header and button areas. A later RPM update fixed the solid background remaining after a delayed blur setup; that fix is not included in this ISO. With the update installed, transparency follows the backdrop's readiness and recovers when it is rebuilt. Text and controls stay sharp.

changes.title: Tray layout
changes.text: App tray icons sit in Quick Settings below the system controls and volume sliders. Large icons fit their cells, spacing is consistent, and small groups are centered. The three-dot button was removed.

changes.title: Tray controls
changes.text: Right-click an icon to pin it to the top bar, return it to Quick Settings, or hide it. These choices are saved, and hidden apps can be restored from the tray's context menu. Menus stay open during refreshes and icon order survives extension reloads.

changes.title: Update indicator
changes.text: InfinityUpdater stays separate from the app tray. Its badge shows the number of available updates.

changes.title: Cancelled installation
changes.text: Cancelling the password prompt keeps available updates on screen. A failed installation reports the error instead of clearing the list.

changes.title: GNOME 51 fixes
changes.text: Fixed an error when drawing rounded workspace previews and removed obsolete arguments from terminal window resizing.

title: Clock, terminal handle and lock screen
summary: Fixed clock alignment, compact-handle detection and lock-screen spacing.

changes.title: Clock
changes.text: The clock stays centered when the time changes or InfinityTerminal opens. Its position is aligned to whole pixels to avoid blurred text.

changes.title: Terminal handle
changes.text: Maximized windows now shrink the handle even when the theme leaves a small gap below the top bar.

changes.title: Lock screen
changes.text: The avatar and password field are centered together, with enough space below the large clock.

changes.title: Dock
changes.text: The adaptive dock has a stronger top edge. Custom border colors are preserved.

title: ARM64 and x64 images with the terminal handle
summary: Both images include the pull-down terminal handle, smaller terminal sizes and dock overlap fixes for live sessions.

changes.title: Open the terminal
changes.text: Click the handle below the clock or drag it down. Release to keep the chosen height. A short drag closes it; Escape cancels the gesture.

changes.title: Handle size
changes.text: The handle shrinks when the terminal is open or a window reaches the top bar. Overview and the lock screen hide it.

changes.title: Terminal height
changes.text: The terminal can be resized below half the screen, down to 96 pixels. Drag its lower edge up to the top bar to hide it.

changes.title: Live-session dock
changes.text: Window overlap detection now works in the live desktop and ignores minimized windows.

changes.title: Downloads
changes.text: ARM64 and x64 images were published to R2. Older files are kept for six minutes after the download links change so cached pages can catch up.

title: Terminal pull handle
summary: InfinityTerminal can now be opened and resized by dragging from the top bar.

changes.title: Click or drag
changes.text: The handle below the clock opens the terminal with a click or downward drag. Releasing it keeps the selected height.

changes.title: Hide the terminal
changes.text: Drag the lower edge back to the top bar, make a short pull, or use the existing keyboard shortcut.

changes.title: Desktop behavior
changes.text: The handle shrinks near windows and stays centered independently of the clock layout. It follows the selected theme and reduced-motion setting.

changes.title: Dock
changes.text: The dock moves out of the way when a window reaches its area, including in the live session.

title: ARM64 and x64 images, NVIDIA and Steam fixes
summary: New Fedora 45 images, direct downloads and fixes for installation, Steam and the desktop tools.

changes.title: Downloads
changes.text: ARM64 and x64 ISOs are available directly from R2. The website reads filenames, sizes and MD5/SHA-256 checksums from the release manifest.

changes.title: NVIDIA installation
changes.text: On supported x64 hardware, installation builds and checks the driver modules before finishing. Driver failures stop installation rather than appearing at first boot. This step needs an internet connection.

changes.title: Steam and TV Mode
changes.text: Both use the working Steam runtime launcher. TV-session startup and exit were corrected. Steam stays closed after setup so its first update can finish from the desktop.

changes.title: InfinityApps and InfinityConfig
changes.text: InfinityApps opens on the System tab and searches across categories. Config's unused search bar was removed. Both apps have their own icons, and grouped setup changes need one administrator authorization.

changes.title: InfinityTerminal
changes.text: Added configurable system readings, timers, Pomodoro, network transfer, battery, weather and a second time zone. The widget row can be reordered. The terminal now starts its opening animation fully above the screen.

changes.title: InfinityUpdater
changes.text: Adjusted the opening animation and button contrast in both themes. Offline updates now show a restart notification. Restart handling and completion messages were fixed.

changes.title: Desktop
changes.text: Adjusted desktop and dock icon sizes and mounted-drive artwork. NowPlay and Raccoon Launcher are included.

changes.title: Live installer
changes.text: Firefox opens the changelog instead of the Fedora start page.
